summary: Orion Digital Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting Q1 2026 financial results. The release highlights Adjusted EBITDA growth of 46% year-over-year, cash increase of 97%, and KPIs for its Wealth and Payments platforms. There are no special-situation events such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure under Rule 13a-16 for a foreign private issuer.
